Title: {LSJ} Approximation of Loyalty in Keepers of Tradition

Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello,

It seems that the capacity requirement to play Approximation of
Loyalty has been lowered :

Approximation of Loyalty
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Presence
****Requires a vampire with capacity 5 or more.****
[pre] Only usable as the action is announced. Choose a vampire with
capacity 6 or less or an ally. That minion cannot block this action.
[PRE] Cancel a reaction card played by a vampire with capacity 6 or
less or an ally as it is played (no cost is paid). No more action
modifiers can be played on this action.

While it was printed until then : "Requires a vampire with capacity
above 6" if I recall correctly.

I would believe it is a misprint if the above text wasn't taken from
the official card list, yet I wonder why this card text change is not
pointed out in the KoT page, for example.

Can a 6-cap with presence really play Approximation of Loyalty ?

Thank you !

François

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
François wrote:
> It seems that the capacity requirement to play Approximation of
> Loyalty has been lowered :

No. Errata to the KoT card: it still requires a capacity of 7 or more.
